routes.label: Apply the definition of an algebraic expression

question: Which of the following is an algebraic expression?
solution: An algebraic expression connects numbers or letters using operation symbols and contains no equality or inequality signs. A is an equation, and C and D contain inequality signs. Only \(2a-b\) is an algebraic expression.
